hero.name: Aswin Raj D
hero.title: Senior Software Engineer / Jira Developer
hero.ledeSuffix: years turning Jira and Confluence into powerful, automated workspaces. I build the scripts, plugins, and dashboards that save teams real time and real money.

about.photoAlt: Aswin Raj D speaking at Atlassian Community Trivandrum
about.textAfter: years of experience, and I've spent much of that time focused on Jira development, building the automations, plugins, and dashboards that take a clunky manual process and make it just work. I like getting to the bottom of why a workflow is broken before I fix it, and I'm always chasing the next tool or technique worth learning. I'm also an Atlassian Community Champion for the Trivandrum chapter, where I've helped run a string of successful meetups and events.

bullets: Build and maintain the automation workflows and plugins that extend what Jira can do.
Design dashboards for Jira Connect add-ons and fine-tune custom fields and filters so teams see exactly what they need.
Turn customer demand straight into working Groovy scripts, without lengthy back-and-forth.
Shipped five standout tools: Project Creation Automation, Archive Issue Search, the WoW Panel, CROWD Admin Finder, and the JMP Self Service Portal.

experience.role: Specialist Application Operations — Jira Admin cum Developer
bullets: Stepped in wherever standard operations hit a wall, writing the custom scripts that got requests unstuck.
Built add-ons and customizations for the Atlassian Jira platform.
Used the Jira API to build workflows, reports, and dashboards that gave stakeholders real visibility.
Kept every plugin stable and compatible, and documented it all so the next person wouldn't have to guess.
Built and supported projects across multiple UST clients, working directly with customers throughout.
Consistently hit project goals and earned client appreciation along the way.
Led "Color Gold," an organizational branding initiative, running industrial visits and high-impact events for the team.
Wrote Jira Groovy (ScriptRunner) scripts and custom workflows, including conditions, validators, and post-functions.
Rolled out and configured key Jira plugins, and ran Jira Data Center on AWS.
Demoed new work to end customers and senior management as part of an Agile/Scrum team.
Partnered closely with clients to pin down requirements and work through problems together.
Proposed a new digitization methodology and checked digitized outputs against the originals.
Built features and components tailored to the client's actual business needs.
Made custom changes to a mainframe database and kept existing custom code running smoothly.
Tested membership claim processing by hand, then combined it with claim adjudication testing.
Built macros that turned slow manual processes into automated ones.

achievements.text: Launched the JMP Self Service Portal with smarter search, my biggest single cost win yet.
Automated project, space, and group creation in Jira, cutting out hours of manual setup.
Built "Archive Issue Search" so old issues are findable in seconds, not searches.
Created a release management feature that doubles as a team knowledge base.
Named an **Atlassian Community Champion** for Trivandrum.
Won the **Navrathna Recognition 2023** and **GEM-Spot Recognition 2023** for picking up new skills fast and putting them to work.
Clocked ~395 learning hours, ranking as top learner on BranchIT 2023.
Finalist at Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2018 in Hubli, Karnataka.
Took first prize in a Raspberry Pi project competition, and later judged projects myself as a jury member for the Raspberry Pi Foundation's "Coolest Projects" initiative.

education.text: B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering — MGU University, Kottayam, Kerala
X — LMS HSS Chemboor, Trivandrum, Kerala

contact.intro: I'm based in Trivandrum, Kerala, and always happy to talk about Jira, automation, or the next interesting problem. Reach out any time.
